characteristics.heroSubtitle: Use SafeRoute’s new features to improve your trips and reach your destination with complete confidence. Our technology guides you through the safest and best-lit paths in real time.
characteristics.cardTitle: Turn dangerous trips into safer routes
characteristics.cardDescription: SafeRoute analyzes risk, lighting, social density, and verified reports to suggest safer urban routes in real time.

aboutus.title: About Us
aboutus.jenniferDescription: I am currently pursuing a degree in Software Engineering at UPC with an interest in becoming a future backend developer. I have knowledge of Java, C++, Vue and also have knowledge in Power BI and Excel.
aboutus.luciaDescription: I am Lucia Zorrilla, I am 20 years old and I am currently studying Systems Engineering at UPC. I am a responsible and organized person. I have knowledge of Python and C++.
aboutus.aldoDescription: I am Aldo Flores, I am 19 years old and I am currently pursuing a degree in Systems Engineering. I consider myself a proactive person who always wants to learn and set new challenges.
aboutus.miguelDescription: I am Miguel Sullon, a Systems Engineering student. I am responsible, I like punctuality in all aspects of my life and I have intermediate English proficiency.
aboutus.giulianoDescription: I am Giuliano Tinoco, I am 19 years old and I am a Systems Engineering student. I am organized, with great motivation to learn, take on challenges and grow both personally and academically.
aboutus.ricardoDescription: I am Ricardo Vargas, I am 19 years old and I study Information Systems Engineering at UPC. I have knowledge of Python and C++.

card1.name: Sarah M.
card1.text: "I used to panic when walking home after night classes. SafeRoute showed me well-lit streets I didn’t even know existed. Now I feel much safer."

card2.name: James R.
card2.text: "The training mode changes everything. I can plan my night runs through populated and well-lit areas. My family also feels more at ease."

card3.name: Maria T.
card3.text: "Working night shifts means long commutes. Companion mode lets my partner follow my route back home. It gives both of us peace of mind."

cta.title: Travel more safely at night
cta.description: Plan safer routes, receive real-time alerts, and share your journey with trusted people.

footer.description: Smart urban navigation platform focused on safe routes at night. Travel with confidence and reach your destination safely.
